threatScenario: An ALLOW admission that was valid for exactly one dispatch is presented again after its one-shot freshness challenge has been consumed. The record is byte-for-byte unchanged, so its content-derived identifier still recomputes; only a gate that checks current freshness and replay state rejects it.

freshness.mechanism: verifier-issued one-shot challenge nonce with a bounded validity window

expectedEnforcementPoint: pre-dispatch admission gate (freshness and replay check)

integrity_check.detail: action_ref recomputes from the unchanged content preimage; no field was altered between first use and replay.

freshness_check.detail: The challenge was consumed at timestamp_ms 1751600100500. A consumed challenge authorizes at most one dispatch, so the record is rejected even though it is unexpired and integrity-valid.

expectedAuditArtifact.property: An ALLOW admission MUST be bound to freshness state controlled by the relying enforcement point. Integrity checks answer whether a record was altered; they do not answer whether this authorization is live and unused now.

freshness.mechanism: verifier-issued one-shot challenge nonce with a bounded validity window

integrity_check.detail: action_ref recomputes from the content preimage.

freshness_check.detail: A fresh, unconsumed, unexpired challenge is bound to this admission.

expectedAuditArtifact.property: The same requested action, freshly admitted under a new challenge, produces a new content-derived identifier and is allowed once.

claimBoundary: This vector demonstrates that the admission gate rejects a replayed or stale admission. It does not prove that the original policy decision was correct, and it does not prove that an external side effect did or did not occur.
notes: Freshness state is issued and consumed by the relying enforcement point, not by the skill. Field names are profile-specific; the property is that replay status is checkable and enforced.

timestamp_ms is audit metadata and part of the action_ref preimage, but a timestamp alone does not establish freshness. This replay occurs inside the validity window, so rejection comes from consumption state rather than expiry.
The admission record is unchanged between first use and replay, and carries no signature because AST09 documents a signature only on the outcome receipt.
